summary: Added ShowThumbnailsTab computed property to MovieEditorViewModel. The property returns true when (ThumbnailsVm != null && !ThumbnailsVm.IsEmpty) || GeneratorVm != null, implementing criterion 4.
Added [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(ShowThumbnailsTab))] to both _thumbnailsVm and _generatorVm fields so the UI updates when either sub-VM is assigned.
Updated OnLinkedThumbnailsChanged to also raise ShowThumbnailsTab PropertyChanged, propagating IsEmpty changes from ThumbnailsVm.
Updated MovieEditorView.axaml Thumbnails TabItem to include IsVisible="{Binding ShowThumbnailsTab}" (compiled binding via existing x:DataType).
Updated Generate TabItem header from 'Generate' to 'Generate Thumbnails' to exactly match acceptance criterion 3.

Updated docs/agents/project-manifest/api-surface.md to document ShowThumbnailsTab.

comments.note: MovieEditorView.axaml: the Generate Thumbnails TabItem has no IsVisible condition. If GeneratorVm is null (image services not injected), the tab is always shown but empty. Consider adding IsVisible="{Binding GeneratorVm, Converter={x:Static ObjectConverters.IsNotNull}}" in a future WP to match the Thumbnails tab's pattern.

MovieEditorViewModel does not implement IDisposable (noted in existing api-surface.md comment). ThumbnailsVm is an IDisposable sub-VM that is only disposed on re-entry into LoadAsync, not when the editor closes normally. This is a documented carry-forward item but worth flagging as it could cause Bitmap memory leaks in long sessions.

ShowThumbnailsTab: the property accesses ThumbnailsVm.IsEmpty directly. If ThumbnailsVm.PropertyChanged fires for reasons other than IsEmpty, OnLinkedThumbnailsChanged won't be triggered (it only fires on Thumbnails.CollectionChanged). A more robust approach would subscribe to ThumbnailsVm.PropertyChanged and filter on IsEmpty — but the current implementation is correct because IsEmpty is always updated in OnThumbnailsCollectionChanged, which also fires CollectionChanged.
